mutations.name: REGRESSION: the 400 comes back for parallel_tool_calls:false — the exact P1 that made Codex CLI 0.164 unusable on its first turn (evidence/ClientSandboxes.md §3.3 C1)
the drop goes silent again: the predicate never fires, so a Codex turn is served with no counter and no warn — indistinguishable from an honoured hint

the predicate ignores the passthrough switch — an operator who set DEVIN_CONNECT_TOOL_CHOICE=1 gets the hint honoured AND counted/warned as dropped, so the counter can no longer tell an ignored hint from an honoured one
the counter is dropped — the only rate signal for an ignored hint is gone; the once-per-process warn then hides every occurrence after the first

the warn fires on every request instead of once per process — every Codex turn logs a warning for a preference the proxy deliberately accepts, which is exactly the cry-wolf noise that makes real warnings invisible
the warn stops naming the event and the switch — the line becomes ungreppable and no longer says how to make the hint honourable
mutations.anchor: log.warn(`Chat[${reqId}]: DEVIN_CONNECT event=parallel_tool_calls_hint_ignored — caller asked for parallel_tool_calls:false and the #11 passthrough is off (DEVIN_CONNECT_TOOL_CHOICE is not "1"; tag unconfirmed), so the request is served without the hint and the upstream may return several calls per turn. Counted per request; logged once per process.`);

mutations.name: streamChat stops forwarding the opt-in fields — the switch is inert on the live route again (DEVIN_CONNECT_TOOL_CHOICE=1 produces no #11)
the handler stops threading parallel_tool_calls into connectParams — the parameter is accepted, counted, and dropped one layer below where the switch could honour it
the handler stops threading tool_choice — the other field behind the same switch stays inert
the /v1/messages F2 mapping is dropped — an Anthropic caller's tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use never becomes the OpenAI-shaped field, so it is neither honoured nor counted
